text: Please can someone help me I'm in a terrible state. I have my granddaughter staying with me, she is 5, and she's been poorly since yesterday with a temperature, it's 38.6 now. I was giving her a wash before bed and I saw marks on her arms and her chest, little dark red and purply spots and a couple of bigger patches like bruises but she hasn't knocked herself, I'd know. I've read about pressing a glass on them so I got a drinking glass and pressed it down firm and they're still there, they don't go pale at all, I can see them right through it. I tried on three different spots. Her mum is on her way but she's a good hour off. I don't drive at night anymore. I'm trying to stay calm for her sake but my hands are shaking. Please tell me what I need to do.
